integrity: The exact finite-field law is proven by a direct incidence and Gaussian-binomial inversion argument; the included finite enumerator is corroboration, not an infinite proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The joint statistic is on the two characteristic graded pieces of a six-dimensional free class-two Lie algebra, not an assertion of the actual fixed-space dimension in non-free cases. Higher generator ranks and exhaustive publication priority are not established.
title: Graded fixed-space profiles of automorphisms of the free class-two Lie algebra on three generators
